lean.name: Formalism.LFunctionChainParameters.LChain.SizeData₂
lean.note: SizeData₂ is the conjunction of the eleven size conditions. ChainTied requires this conjunction for the data at its chosen scale. This predicate is the conjunction of the eleven size clauses used by ChainTied.
